en.summary: Fixes operand-collector request bookkeeping by carrying full extended register indices through the transient request path and by realigning bank-response selection metadata with synchronous register-bank reads.
why_it_counts: The patch changes operand fetch logic in the core pipeline.
It corrects functional request and response bookkeeping between collector units, bank arbiters, and register files.
The failing mechanism is a concrete control and data alignment bug that can be reinjected.
disqualifiers: The commit message says the fix is not complete.
The commit also changes test timeouts.
evidence: collectorUnit widens regIdxWire from 5 bits to 8 bits and introduces validWire in the same request path.
operandCollector.scala removes RegNext from crossBar chosen and valid signals, so crossbar routing uses the current bank grant metadata instead of a delayed copy.
regfile.scala removes the old Mux(RegNext(io.rsidx.orR), regs.read(io.rsidx), 0.U) path and reads the current rsidx directly when bypass is not active.
Only operandCollector.scala and regfile.scala are DUT logic changes; the remaining file is a test update.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: In a banked operand collector, the metadata that identifies which collector slot requested a bank read must stay time-aligned with the bank data that returns. If the grant tags are delayed relative to the synchronous bank read, or if temporary register indices are truncated before bank address formation, the returned operand can be delivered to the wrong operand slot or fetched from the wrong logical register. The visible effect is wrong source operands or a collector that waits on an operand that was misrouted.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: banked operand-collector request and response tagging
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: An instruction issues operand reads through a synchronous banked register file, especially when collector arbitration and extended register numbering are both active.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Reintroduce a one-cycle skew between bank-read data and the associated selection tags, and if the design supports extended register identifiers, truncate the temporary request index before bank address generation.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: insert stray pipeline register on arbiter tag path; narrow transient register index bus
portability_notes: Map this to any operand collector, scoreboarding read stage, or banked register-read crossbar that separately transports data and grant metadata.
If the target DUT has no extended register numbering, the timing skew alone is still a valid and reusable injection.
The important property is that the tag telling the crossbar where bank data belongs no longer matches the cycle of the bank output.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the path that carries collector ID, operand slot, or grant winner information from the bank arbiter into the bank-response crossbar.
Insert one extra register stage on that tag path without adding the same delay to the bank data path.
If the design has temporary decoded register indices wider than the architectural base field, shrink that temporary bus back to the narrower width before bank selection and address calculation.
Leave writeback bypass logic intact so the failure is dominated by mis-tagged or truncated operand fetches rather than unrelated write hazards.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: collectorUnit temporary reg-index and valid bookkeeping, plus operandCollector crossbar grant alignment with scalar-bank reads
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The commit widens regIdxWire to 8 bits, adds validWire in collectorUnit, removes RegNext from readchosen and readArbiterOut-valid before the crossBar, and replaces the old gated scalar-bank read expression with a direct current-index read.
repository_grounding.mutation_strategy: restore old metadata delay and narrow transient indices
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Reinsert RegNext on readchosen and readArbiterOut valid before crossBar routing, shrink collectorUnit regIdxWire back to 5 bits, and restore the older gated scalar-bank read expression in RegFileBank.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Returned register-bank data is associated with the wrong operand slot or wrong logical register, causing stale operands, incorrect execution results, or operand-collector stalls.
evidence_for_injection: The pre-fix code delayed crossBar chosen and valid metadata with RegNext even though the bank output routing depended on that metadata.
The same patch also corrected a transient 5-bit register-index wire even though collector state already stored a wider register index.
The scalar register bank previously zero-gated reads using RegNext(io.rsidx.orR), which the fix removed while keeping bypass behavior.
notes: The timing-skew mutation is the most portable form of this bug.
The register-index truncation is a source-grounded secondary mutation that matters when the DUT supports extended register identifiers.

zh.summary: 该提交通过在瞬时请求路径中保留完整的扩展寄存器索引，并让 bank 返回选择元数据与同步寄存器 bank 读数据重新对齐，修复了 operand collector 的请求记账问题。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改的是核心流水线中的操作数获取逻辑。
它修正了 collector 单元、bank 仲裁器和寄存器文件之间真实的请求与响应记账关系。
失效机制是具体的控制和数据对齐错误，能够被重新注入。
disqualifiers: 提交信息明确说该修复还不完整。
提交中还混入了测试超时改动。
evidence: collectorUnit 把 regIdxWire 从 5 位扩成 8 位，并在同一条请求路径上加入 validWire。
operandCollector.scala 去掉了 crossBar 上 chosen 和 valid 信号前的 RegNext，使交叉开关使用当前周期的 bank grant 元数据，而不是延后一拍的副本。
regfile.scala 删除了旧的 Mux(RegNext(io.rsidx.orR), regs.read(io.rsidx), 0.U) 读路径，在非旁路情况下直接读取当前 rsidx。
除了测试更新外，真正的 DUT 逻辑改动只在 operandCollector.scala 和 regfile.scala。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 在带 bank 的 operand collector 中，标识“哪个 collector 槽位发起了 bank 读请求”的元数据必须与返回的 bank 数据严格时序对齐。如果 grant tag 相对同步 bank 读数据多延后一拍，或者在 bank 地址形成前把临时寄存器索引截短，那么返回的操作数就可能被送到错误的操作数字段，或者直接从错误的逻辑寄存器读取。可见后果就是源操作数错误，或者 collector 一直等待一个已经被错误路由的操作数。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: banked operand collector 的请求与响应标记路径
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 指令通过同步的 banked 寄存器文件读取操作数，且 collector 仲裁与扩展寄存器编号同时参与时。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 重新引入 bank 读数据与其选择标签之间的一拍错位；如果设计支持扩展寄存器编号，再把临时请求索引在生成 bank 地址前截回较窄位宽。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 在仲裁标签路径上插入多余寄存器；缩窄临时寄存器索引总线
portability_notes: 可映射到任何把数据路径与 grant 元数据路径分开传递的 operand collector、scoreboard 读阶段或 banked register-read crossbar。
如果目标 DUT 没有扩展寄存器编号，仅重新引入时序错位也仍然是有效且可复用的注入方式。
关键性质是：crossbar 用来判定 bank 数据归属的标签周期，不再与 bank 输出数据所在周期一致。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到从 bank 仲裁器传到 bank-response crossbar 的 collector ID、操作数字段编号或 grant winner 标签路径。
只在该标签路径上插入一个额外寄存器级，而不要对 bank 数据路径做同样延迟。
如果设计里存在比架构基础字段更宽的临时寄存器索引，把该总线在 bank 选择和地址计算前缩回较窄位宽。
保持写回旁路逻辑不变，让故障主要体现为操作数读取被错误标记或索引被截断，而不是其他写后读冒险。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: collectorUnit 中临时 reg-index 和 valid 记账，以及 operandCollector 中 crossbar grant 与 scalar bank 读结果的对齐逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该提交把 regIdxWire 扩到 8 位，在 collectorUnit 中加入 validWire，去掉了 crossBar 前 readchosen 和 readArbiterOut-valid 上的 RegNext，并把 scalar bank 的旧门控读表达式改成直接使用当前索引读取。
repository_grounding.mutation_strategy: 恢复旧的元数据延迟并缩窄临时索引
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 crossBar 路由前重新给 readchosen 和 readArbiterOut valid 加上 RegNext，把 collectorUnit 的 regIdxWire 缩回 5 位，并在 RegFileBank 中恢复较早的门控读表达式。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 返回的寄存器 bank 数据会被绑定到错误的操作数字段或错误的逻辑寄存器，导致源操作数陈旧、执行结果错误，或 operand collector 卡住。
evidence_for_injection: 修复前代码会用 RegNext 延迟 crossBar 的 chosen 和 valid 元数据，但 bank 输出路由又依赖这些元数据。
同一补丁还修正了一个临时 5 位寄存器索引线，而 collector 内部保存的状态本来已经更宽。
scalar 寄存器 bank 之前会用 RegNext(io.rsidx.orR) 对读出做零门控，修复后删除了这段逻辑，同时保留了旁路机制。
notes: 最可移植的故障形式是重新引入时序错位。
寄存器索引截断是基于源仓库补丁得到的次级变异，在 DUT 支持扩展寄存器编号时更重要。
